titleEn: 400+ crop robotics companies, but where are robots really gaining ground?
titleZh: 400多家作物机器人公司，但机器人在哪里真正取得进展？
summaryZh: 全球已有400多家公司开发用于粮食作物生产的机器人，较2024年增长超20%。然而供应商的快速增长并不意味着农场采用速度同样快。2026年作物机器人全景图揭示了机器人在哪些领域真正获得 traction，种植者和行业专家解释了有前景的技术与已能在田间证明价值的设备之间的区别。
featuredReason: 该文提供了全球作物机器人行业的最新全景数据（400+公司，增长20%+），并区分了技术前景与实际田间采用之间的差距，对智慧畜牧行业人士理解农业自动化落地瓶颈和投资方向具有重要参考价值。
contentFull:
400+ crop robotics companies, but where are robots really gaining ground?

 21-09 | Field robots | Article

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

The full 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape graphic. Image: The Mixing Bowl

 More than 400 companies worldwide are now developing robotics for food crop production, more than 20% more than in 2024. But rapid growth in suppliers does not mean equally rapid adoption on farms. The new 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape shows where robots are gaining real traction — and growers and industry experts explain what separates promising technology from equipment that can already earn its place in the field.
